visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) An adult woman with long black hair, wearing a beige sleeveless top, stands outside in front of a 7-Eleven store. She smiles at the camera, gesturing with her hand near her face and pointing at the store sign. (2) A screen recording of the 'uniopen' mobile app appears, showing a user entering a referral code and viewing their OPENPOINT balance. (3) The woman is shown outdoors again, this time in front of a Starbucks storefront, holding her iPhone and displaying the app's interface while smiling and talking. (4) Close-up shots show the woman at a checkout counter, presenting a barcode on her phone screen to a scanner. The background shows shelves and typical retail interior elements. (5) The woman stands before a 'Cosmed' store entrance, identified by its bright red sign. She continues to interact with her phone and speak to the camera. (6) A young girl in a plaid skirt and glasses stands in front of a 7-Eleven mascot statue, holding three different beverage bottles. The setting is bright daylight. (7) Returning to the original woman in front of the 7-Eleven, she winks, smiles, and gestures towards the camera, encouraging the viewer to download the app.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A cheerful female voice introduces the video with high energy and positive valence. The BGM consists of an upbeat acoustic guitar strumming and a steady pop drum rhythm at ~120 BPM in a major mode. The ambient environment is a quiet outdoor city street. (2) As the screen recording plays, a subtle digital UI 'pop' sound effect is audible when buttons are clicked. The main speaker continues her explanation at a moderate, clear pace. The BGM remains steady in volume. (3) The audio captures the speaker's voice in various locations (Starbucks, Cosmed); though the acoustic texture shifts slightly to an indoor room tone, her voice remains the dominant signal. (4) A second female voice, belonging to a younger child, speaks briefly with a higher pitch and excited intonation. The BGM persists underneath. (5) The primary speaker returns to conclude with a call to action. The BGM fades out quickly at the end of the 60-second duration.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote the 'uniopen' rewards application by demonstrating how to earn points through referral codes and showing its versatility for use at major retail chains like 7-Eleven, Starbucks, and Cosmed.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator directly mentions the app name, shows the download process, and encourages the use of a specific referral code.
